Messages.Author: Henke
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I've downloaded the Archon spredsheet tournament tracker and got one
question...

If I use the "V:TES Optimal Tournament Seating", is also the order (and not
only which players sit at which table) decided from the start? I.e. should
there be no randomization at the start of each round to see in which order
the players at a given table should sit? And also, should the first player
in the Seating table start to play, or should that be randomized?

Thanks
/Henke

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The "starting order" (i.e., who gets to be "player 1") should be
randomized at the start of the tournament.

The charts are designed so that the first player listed at a table plays
first, the second plays second (is the prey of the first), and so on.

If you attempt to randomize the order at a table, you could end up
repeating the same predator-prey relationship between two players.

If you randomize who goes first, you could end up with the same player
playing 1st (or 2nd, etc.) more than once during the course of the
tournament.
